description: This file defines basic types and utility functions used in model classes for the behave testing framework, including enums for test statuses, file location handling, and helper functions.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Enum representing various test execution statuses, including untested, skipped, passed, failed, error, hook errors, pending, undefined, and execution states.

classes.name: ScenarioStatus
classes.description: Utility class to derive scenario status from step statuses.

classes.name: OuterStatus
classes.description: Utility class to derive feature or rule status from contained model elements.

classes.name: FileLocation
classes.description: Class representing a file location with filename and optional line number, providing methods for path manipulation and comparison.

classes.name: Argument
classes.description: Class representing an argument in a feature file step, including original text, value, name, and position indices.

methods.name: posixpath_normalize
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a path for POSIX compatibility.

methods.name: make_relpath_if_possible
methods.description: Attempts to compute a relative path from a base directory to a filename.

methods.name: unwrap_function
methods.description: Unwraps a function wrapped with functools.partial or similar wrappers.
